title: What Is Normal Blood Pressure by Age? (35+ Guide)
description: Blood pressure goals change with age—68% of adults 65+ have hypertension. Learn your target range and when to act, step-by-step.
reasoning: People are searching 'bp care' because rising awareness of home monitoring, new ACC/AHA guidelines, and aging baby boomers are driving urgent questions about personalized, age-specific BP targets—not just generic 'high vs low' definitions.
perplexityQuestions: What is my blood pressure today, and is it the same as at other visits?
What should my blood pressure goal be at age 35, 45, 55, or older?
Is 135/85 considered high blood pressure for adults?
Should I be checking my blood pressure at home, and how often?
